editorialIntro.heading: Does Oceania Cruises Include Drinks in the Cruise Fare?
paragraphs: Yes. Oceania Cruises includes a generous selection of nonalcoholic beverages in its standard cruise experience, and eligible bookings also offer a choice between complimentary wine and beer or a shore excursion credit through the Your World Included program.

However, the included beverage selection is not an unlimited alcoholic-drinks package. Guests who want broader access to cocktails, spirits, Champagne and wine by the glass may consider purchasing the Prestige Select Beverage Package.

Oceania's beverage arrangements are particularly important to understand before booking because the value depends on what you drink, how often you visit bars and lounges, and whether you select the wine-and-beer amenity or shore excursion credit.

alwaysIncludedSection.title: Oceania's Your World Included Beverage Program
intro: Oceania's Your World Included program provides an extensive selection of complimentary beverages as part of the core cruise experience.
The program clearly distinguishes its always-included nonalcoholic amenities from the additional promotional amenity choice available on eligible bookings.

items.title: Always-Included Nonalcoholic Beverages
paragraphs: Unlike contemporary cruise lines that charge per can of soda or cup of espresso, Oceania includes an impressive array of daily nonalcoholic beverages for every guest aboard.
These benefits significantly reduce out-of-pocket spending for guests who regularly enjoy barista-made espresso drinks, sodas, and purified water.
Available throughout all restaurants, lounges, open decks, and room service.

lists.title: Included Nonalcoholic Selections
items: Handcrafted specialty coffees: espresso, double espresso, cappuccino, latte, and macchiato at Baristas
Artisanal loose-leaf and bag teas served in dining rooms, Horizon Lounge, and traditional afternoon tea
Unlimited Coca-Cola, Diet Coke, Sprite, ginger ale, tonic water, and sodas
Eco-friendly, crystal-pure still and sparkling Vero Water served in custom glassware
Fresh cold-pressed juices, morning wellness shots, and fruit smoothies
Gourmet artisan gelato and premium ice cream by the scoop at Waves Grill and Terrace Café

items.title: The Complimentary Wine and Beer Amenity Choice
paragraphs: Eligible bookings made under the current Your World Included program allow guests to choose between Complimentary Wine and Beer or a Shore Excursion Credit.
Choosing the wine-and-beer option provides a curated selection of wines by the glass and beers from the General Bar Menu during lunch and dinner operating hours.
Available in all restaurants and lounges during designated dining periods, as well as via complimentary room service.

lists.title: Important Booking Conditions to Note
items: Guests sharing the same stateroom must select the same amenity (both choose wine/beer or both choose excursion credit)
The amenity selection must be finalized by the final payment date under published booking terms
The benefit covers red, white, rosé, sparkling wine, Champagne by the glass, and selected draft/bottled beers
Does not cover cocktails, neat spirits, premier bottled cellar wines, or drinks ordered outside meal hours
Third and fourth guests in the same stateroom are excluded from the amenity under standard terms

breakEvenScenarios.title: Is the Oceania Drink Package Worth It?
breakEvenScenarios.subtitle: EVALUATING VALUE ACROSS 3 DISTINCT TRAVELER PROFILES

items.title: The Occasional Wine Drinker
items.lead: Prefers 1–2 glasses of wine with dinner and nonalcoholic drinks during the day
items.description: If you primarily drink artisan coffees, iced tea, and sparkling Vero Water during the daytime and only enjoy a glass or two of wine with lunch and dinner, the complimentary Wine and Beer amenity provides all the coverage you need.
features: Specialty coffees, teas, and sodas already 100% complimentary
Wine and beer with meals covered by Your World Included
Purchasing Prestige Select would add unnecessary expense ($80/day)
Occasional cocktails can easily be purchased à la carte ($12–$16)
items.highlight: Recommendation: Stick with Complimentary Wine & Beer; skip the package.

items.title: The Cocktail & Spirits Enthusiast
items.lead: Enjoys poolside cocktails, pre-dinner martinis, and late-night lounge drinks
items.description: If your cruise vacation involves poolside mojitos, gin and tonics during afternoon trivia, a pre-dinner martini at Martinis lounge, wine with dinner, and a nightcap, Prestige Select delivers tremendous value.
features: Break-even calculation: 5 cocktails or mixed drinks per day ($15 average)
50% upgrade discount ($39.98/day) drops break-even to just 2.6 drinks/day
Complete peace of mind with zero bar chits to sign all cruise
Covers premium spirits, Champagne, and after-dinner cordials
items.highlight: Recommendation: Prestige Select is an exceptional investment (especially at 50% off).

items.title: The Light or Non-Alcoholic Drinker
items.lead: Rarely or never drinks alcohol; prioritizes shore exploration and wellness
items.description: For travelers who do not drink alcohol, Oceania is paradise. Unlike contemporary lines that force nonalcoholic beverage packages, Oceania includes Vero Water, espresso, sodas, and cold-pressed juices at no charge.
features: Select the Shore Excursion Credit amenity instead of Wine & Beer
Enjoy unlimited Baristas espresso, lattes, and cappuccinos free
Savor Aquamar Kitchen smoothies and fresh juices daily at no cost
Zero need for any beverage package purchase
items.highlight: Recommendation: Choose Shore Excursion Credit; zero beverage packages needed.

gratuityAndVenues.title: Gratuity Policies & Where to Enjoy Your Drinks
gratuityAndVenues.subtitle: UNDERSTANDING SERVICE CHARGES & ONBOARD DRINK VENUES

cards.title: How Beverage Gratuities Work on Oceania
items: Standard cruise fares include shipboard staff gratuities for stateroom stewards, restaurant servers, and galley staff.
Separately purchased alcoholic beverages ordered à la carte incur an automatic 20% service gratuity on the bar slip.
Purchasing the Prestige Select Beverage Package includes the service charge in the package rate or adds 20% at checkout depending on promotion.
Drinks ordered under the Complimentary Wine and Beer amenity carry zero extra service charges or gratuity fees.
Always verify your onboard folio on the Oceania app or at Guest Services to ensure accurate beverage billing.

cards.title: Where You Can Use Your Beverage Benefits
items: Martinis Bar: Signature martinis, live piano music, and elegant evening gatherings.
Grand Bar & Lounge: Pre-dinner cocktails and fine wines before dining in The Grand Dining Room.
Horizon Lounge: Panoramic observation lounge serving afternoon tea, sunset drinks, and evening music.
Waves Bar: Casual poolside bar serving refreshing frozen cocktails, draft beers, and mocktails.
Specialty Restaurants: Polo Grill, Toscana, Jacques, and Red Ginger during dinner service.
Room Service: Beverage privileges apply to in-room dining orders during regular bar operating hours.

purchasingTimeline.title: How & When to Purchase Your Oceania Drink Package
purchasingTimeline.subtitle: A PRACTICAL 4-PHASE GUIDE TO SECURING OPTIMAL BEVERAGE VALUE

steps.title: Phase 1: Select Your World Included Amenity
steps.description: At the time of booking (or prior to final payment), decide whether you prefer Complimentary Wine & Beer or the Shore Excursion Credit with your travel advisor.

steps.title: Phase 2: Check for Loyalty & Upgrade Discounts
steps.description: If you selected Wine & Beer, review your booking in Oceania My Account to confirm eligibility for the published 50% discount to upgrade to Prestige Select (~$39.98/day).

steps.title: Phase 3: Purchase Pre-Cruise in My Account
steps.description: Pre-purchasing beverage packages before departure locks in promotional rates, applies Oceania Club loyalty savings where applicable, and ensures instant package activation on day one.

steps.title: Phase 4: Verify Folio on Embarkation Day
steps.description: Upon boarding, check your keycard for the beverage package indicator. Visit any bar or Guest Services to confirm your package status before ordering your first drink.

expertTips.title: Expert Tips for Getting the Most From Oceania Beverage Benefits
expertTips.subtitle: INSIDER STRATEGIES FROM CERTIFIED CRUISE ADVISORS

items.title: Confirm Amenity by Final Payment
items.description: Your choice between Complimentary Wine and Beer and Shore Excursion Credit must be locked in before your final payment deadline.

items.title: Evaluate the 50% Upgrade Promo
items.description: Upgrading to Prestige Select from the Wine and Beer amenity at 50% off ($39.98/day) is one of the greatest values in luxury cruising.

items.title: Factor in Free Nonalcoholic Drinks
items.description: Remember that espresso, Vero water, juices, and sodas are already free—do not over-purchase alcohol packages if you drink mostly coffee and water.

items.title: Calculate Your Port Days
items.description: On port-intensive itineraries with 10-hour days ashore, you may only drink 1 or 2 glasses of wine at dinner, reducing package value.

items.title: Review the General Bar Menu
items.description: Oceania's standard bar menu includes reputable wine labels and quality liquors. Premium cellar bottles are rarely necessary.

items.title: Use Prestige Select via Room Service
items.description: Take advantage of package privileges by ordering glasses of wine or cocktails delivered directly to your stateroom or veranda.

items.title: Mind the Exclusions
items.description: Bottles of wine, premier rare spirits, sake, and La Reserve wine-pairing dinners are not covered by Prestige Select.

items.title: Budget for the 20% Bar Gratuity
items.description: À la carte drinks ordered without a package automatically carry a 20% service gratuity on the final folio.

items.title: Stateroom Companion Alignment
items.description: Guests sharing a stateroom generally must select the same Your World Included amenity, so coordinate preferences in advance.

items.title: Compare Total Cruise Value
items.description: Beverages are just one component of Oceania's high-value proposition alongside free specialty dining, Wi-Fi, and gratuities.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Oceania Cruises Drink Packages
faqs.subtitle: EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO KNOW ABOUT COSTS, INCLUSIONS & POLICIES

questions.question: Does Oceania Cruises include drinks in the cruise fare?
questions.answer: Yes. Selected nonalcoholic beverages, including specialty coffees, teas, sodas, juices, smoothies and Vero Water, are included. Eligible bookings can also choose Complimentary Wine and Beer or a shore excursion credit.

questions.question: Does Oceania Cruises have an unlimited drink package?
questions.answer: Oceania offers the Prestige Select Beverage Package, which covers selected wines, Champagne, beers, spirits and cocktails. It has exclusions (such as wine by the bottle and premier spirits), so it should not be interpreted as unlimited access to every beverage onboard.

questions.question: How much is the Oceania Prestige Select Beverage Package?
questions.answer: Oceania's published reference price is $79.95 per person, per day. Guests who select the Complimentary Wine and Beer amenity through Your World Included may be eligible to upgrade to Prestige Select at 50% off.

questions.question: Is wine included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Selected wine by the glass is included when eligible guests select the Complimentary Wine and Beer amenity under Your World Included. The benefit is subject to the applicable menu and operating hours.

questions.question: Is beer included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Selected beer from the General Bar Menu is included when the Complimentary Wine and Beer amenity is selected, subject to current operating hours.

questions.question: Are cocktails included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Selected cocktails are included in the Prestige Select Beverage Package. They are not automatically covered by the standard nonalcoholic beverage benefits or the Complimentary Wine and Beer amenity.

questions.question: Are spirits included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Selected spirits are covered by the Prestige Select Beverage Package. Premier spirits are excluded under the published package terms.

questions.question: Does Oceania Cruises include Champagne?
questions.answer: Selected Champagne offerings by the glass may be available through the Complimentary Wine and Beer amenity or Prestige Select package. Premium bottles and excluded reserve vintages cost extra.

questions.question: Are soft drinks free on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Yes. Sodas, tonic water, and fountain soft drinks are completely included as part of the Your World Included beverage benefits.

questions.question: Is specialty coffee included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Yes. Selected specialty coffees and teas are included, including espresso, cappuccino, latte, and macchiato crafted at Baristas and in all dining venues.

questions.question: Is bottled water included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Still and sparkling Vero Water is included. Other bottled or specialty water selections should be checked against the onboard beverage menu.

questions.question: Are juices and smoothies included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Yes. Selected cold-pressed juices and fruit smoothies are included through Your World Included, including wellness selections at Aquamar Kitchen.

questions.question: Is the Oceania drink package worth buying?
questions.answer: It depends on how much you drink and which beverages you prefer. Guests who mainly drink coffee, tea, water, soft drinks and selected wine or beer with meals rarely need Prestige Select. Guests who regularly order cocktails and spirits throughout the day will find the 50% upgrade discount highly rewarding.

questions.question: Can I upgrade Complimentary Wine and Beer to Prestige Select?
questions.answer: Oceania's published terms state that guests who select Complimentary Wine and Beer may be eligible to upgrade to Prestige Select at 50% off (approximately $39.98 per person, per day).

questions.question: Can I choose wine and beer instead of shore excursion credit?
questions.answer: Yes. Eligible bookings can choose one of the two Your World Included amenities: Complimentary Wine and Beer or Shore Excursion Credit. Guests in the same stateroom generally need to select the same amenity.

questions.question: Can I change my Your World Included amenity choice?
questions.answer: The published terms state that the choice must be made by final payment. Contact Oceania or your travel advisor to confirm whether a change is still possible for your specific reservation.

questions.question: Does the wine-and-beer benefit work in bars and lounges?
questions.answer: The benefit is subject to operating-hour and venue terms. Oceania's published information describes availability at onboard venues during specified lunch and dinner bar and lounge periods.

questions.question: Can I use the Prestige Select package for room service?
questions.answer: Yes. Oceania's published package description includes use through room service during applicable bar operating hours, subject to package terms.

questions.question: Does Prestige Select include wine by the bottle?
questions.answer: No. Wine by the bottle is an explicit exclusion in the published Prestige Select package description.

questions.question: Are premium spirits included in Prestige Select?
questions.answer: Premier ultra-luxury spirits are excluded. The package covers selected quality spirits from the applicable General Bar Menu.
